text:
noah: Morning everyone, day 1 here. Two quick security/setup questions: my YubiKey won't register in Okta and I can't complete the VPN profile. Who should I ping first? :wave:
it-ops: welcome @noah! Start with Device Ops for the YubiKey. Flow: Okta SSO -> add 2FA -> register security key. Did you click the 'Finish device setup' card in Okta?

noah: I clicked it. macOS 13.6.1 on an M1 MBP. When I try to register the key the browser times out. Running `pkcs11-tool --list-objects` returns a permission error.

maria: @noah make sure MDM and FileVault finished enrolling first. We push a small cert/profile needed for key registration. Can you run `profiles status -type enrollment` and paste output?

noah: I haven't toggled FileVault manually. Afraid to break anything. I'll run `sudo fdesetup status` now.

sam: Policy requires FileVault enabled. If it's blocking, IT can assist. Also check if your YubiKey needs a USB-C adapter (some are NFC-only).

noah: `FileVault is On.` Okta still shows 2FA incomplete and the key registration times out.

it-ops: try a different USB port, disable any local password managers, and check System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> External Accessories. If it still fails, open a hardware ticket and include `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` output. We can do a remote screenshare.

noah: second question: the mandatory phishing-sim training is scheduled while I'm traveling Wed-Fri next week with limited access. Can I get an extension?

security: yes — we can grant a one-week extension or mark it remote-complete. DM people-ops with your travel dates and return date. Note: micro-sim follow-ups are rolling and can't be fully exempted.

people-ops: please add a travel exception to the onboarding checklist (https://intra.redwood/workflows/onboard-exception) and attach travel dates. We'll coordinate with Security to update deadlines.

okta-bot: Okta: SSO enrollment completed for noah (device fingerprint matched).

noah: replugged, tried both ports, checked enrollment (`profiles status -type enrollment` shows MDM enrolled). Still timing out registering the key. Opening a ticket now with logs and `system_profiler` output.

it-ops: thanks. If you prefer, we can schedule an HQ drop-in for physical debugging. As a fallback we'll register TOTP so you can access resources today and migrate to the YubiKey later.

maria: noted — we'll help with TOTP registration as temporary.

noah: thanks all, appreciate the quick help and the extension option. :pray:

people-ops: welcome aboard! Ping us if you need badge access or lab drop-in. We'll loop Security in the ticket to confirm the phishsim extension.

security: following up in the ticket for micro-sim scheduling and extension approval. :lock:
